answer: The garden keeps a row for every maker, listing all its identities, and issues one violet for each epoch an identity's own work is judged good. The forge sells a trade seal for as many violets as the maker's row will list with the applicant in it, so a maker's k-th identity must earn k violets by its own labour first: a thousand clones spend five hundred thousand epochs of work, the last of them a thousand, while an honest newcomer whose maker holds one identity earns one violet, buys one seal and trades.
